mapper.select: SELECT CAR_NO carNo , CAR_NAME carName , CAR_PLATE carPlate , MAX_PASSENGER maxPassenger , COLOR color , STATUS status , REGISTER_DATE registerDate , CAR_LOCATION carLocation , CAR_BRAND carBrand FROM TB_CAR WHERE STATUS = 'Y' ORDER BY REGISTER_DATE DESC

SELECT CAR_NO carNo , CAR_NAME carName , CAR_PLATE carPlate , MAX_PASSENGER maxPassenger , COLOR color , STATUS status , REGISTER_DATE registerDate , CAR_LOCATION carLocation , CAR_BRAND carBrand , IMG_ID , ORIGIN_NAME , CHANGE_NAME , FROM TB_CAR LEFT JOIN TB_CAR_IMG USING (CAR_NO) LEFT JOIN TB_CAR_FILE USING (CAR_NO) WHERE TB_CAR.STATUS = 'Y' AND CAR_NO = #{carNo} AND TB_CAR_IMG.STATUS = 'Y'
